lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. Three words are asked of Brandon and all three still stand. One: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first, asked in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday. Two: take the level line's mend, yes or no, asked in Status 262. Three: take the third what-if, fall's lit faces going out before winter's base comes, yes or no, asked in Status 263. The work goes on in any case and only the freeze waits.

The counter of broken pixels that works on Windows (decision 311). Its third measure is read whole and meets both bars set beforehand: the counting pass alone takes 0.43 percent of a frame's draw at 1920 wide, and over five runs the trial against the main branch reads +2.52, -0.21, -0.18, +1.08 and +0.00 percent, median +0.00 (stated by its builder as measured on its machine). Not hidden: two of the five runs read over 1 percent by themselves, cause unknown. At 4K the pass is 0.73 percent of a draw and 0.91 percent with the count's read back, for the record. The piece is merged here and stands at its gate as chain 47 since 5:26 AM MT: the eight guard stills, the measures, the whole test suite and the change's four peaks at 4K must equal chain 46's. Reports are due at about 6:00 AM MT. Until that gate closes the main branch on the repo stays at Status 263's commit and the log's newest entries are on the log branch.

The render instructions for his computer. The builder's last report is read whole and its pictures looked at. Measured here on its last head: the file RENDER-ON-YOUR-PC.md is 549 lines, and the merge brings 50 new files and 4 changed ones, none in the app's source. Stated by its builder: the proven head passed all ten hosted jobs on Windows and macOS, among them the short test at 4K through Direct3D 11; the last head holds a later main branch and is not proven on a hosted machine. It is taken and merges as chain 48 right after chain 47, with a stamp for the main branch's engine so that step 1 of the file runs from the first minute. Two fresh readers are reading the file cold, as the agent on his machine would, due by 6:35 AM MT. It is not on the main branch yet and Partner is told when it is. The full render stays refused by the tool until his word. Unknown and said: everything on a real graphics card, a whole render at 4K anywhere, and his private clone with his sign in.

The third what-if at 4K: all eight pairs of frames are in. Seen here at their own size at film frames 2806, 2812 and 2828, the main branch above and the what-if below: the ladders of fine bars on the twigs, the web's grey wedge, the pale dotted patches at the ends of the base's top and the copper dashes stand in both, so they are the main branch's (open item 291) and not the what-if's. What differs is the burning faces and two small lit places beside them, which are out in the what-if. Its weak point stays as said: once out, the pumpkins are dull dark rounds. It waits for his word.

The first two what-ifs. The sand mound's first version fails at film frames 2107 and 2110 too, a fringe of bristles and a striped patch where the main branch draws one smear. Its rework is due by 5:50 AM MT and the leaves' rework by 6:20 AM MT, the leaves' bar being that every leaf that moves at the landing is one soft smear at 4K. Each is drawn at 4K before it is offered.

The page's lost drawing context, item 294. Its builder's first word came at 5:29 AM MT: no line of the page listens for the loss, which explains the 62 console messages of the one hosted loss. Its way is taken: the page lays the season's still, stops, and loads itself again once at the season it showed, never twice within 120 s, and after that shows the plain notice. Whole report due by 6:50 AM MT, then a fresh critic and a chain. The Windows shader warning (item 282) goes to it as a separate commit that can be taken or left: the live page would no longer write the compiler's warning into the console, the shader text untouched.

The controls' rework for an early shake, item 285: its branch carries a new head, read at 5:37 AM MT, and its whole report is due by 5:50 AM MT. Then the same hosted measure with it and a second one without it. No ruling before those are read.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. The what-ifs, each shown before and after at 4K, none merged without his word. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last the fresh review and BUILD COMPLETE. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 5:38 AM MT: 52 calls), no call since 10:47 PM MT Wednesday. No film render and no new preview video. The live page is the sixteenth publish, unchanged since 2:57 AM MT.
phase 6: 57.82 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 57.82 h used of 12.00 h allowed
